entries.dialogueText: I cut the ribbon which led to a huge wave of cheering from the crowd. Many flashes went off at the same time.
entries.menuText: Cut the ribbon.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Congratulations to all. It was a s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Congratulations to all. It was a solid and fruitful effort. Hopefully with much more to come.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's a good moment indeed. We have..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a good moment indeed. We have helped so many in the countryside.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The train is prepared and ready.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The train is prepared and ready.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A red ribbon was hanging by the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: A red ribbon was hanging by the door of the train.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Sounds fantastic. The President ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sounds fantastic. The President arriving to Lachaven on the driver seat would make the headlines for sure.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We arrived in Holsord for the grand..."
entries.dialogueText: We arrived in Holsord for the grand opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed rail. It was a proud moment for all of us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon and Gus, who heavily assisted..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon and Gus, who heavily assisted the project, were with me along with Lucian to decide on how to proceed tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I don't support anything beyond th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. Actions speak for themselves anyway.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Thank you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I see your point. But involving th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I see your point. But involving the President further could be beneficial for the administration.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I entered the cab and took a seat w..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered the cab and took a seat with the assistant beside me. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me sitting as driver of the train.
entries.menuText: Enter train.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Alright then. We have a lot of wor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do tomorrow. See you in the morning.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It's been a long time since the la..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. There is good reason to capitalise on the occasion.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd like Gus with me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd like Gus with me.”
entries.menuText: “I'd like Gus with me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will drive the train on my own.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will drive the train on my own.”
entries.menuText: “I will drive the train on my own.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon walked up beside me."
entries.dialogueText: Symon walked up beside me.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'm honored. It will be great to a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm honored. It will be great to arrive in Lachaven with the President of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I want to have Symon in the cab.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”
entries.menuText: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Who do you want to travel with in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Who do you want to travel with in the cab, Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lucian, you would be my preference..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian, you would be my preference.”
entries.menuText: “Lucian, you would be my preference.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This isn't necessary but I won't r..."
entries.dialogueText: “This isn't necessary but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you, Mr. President. It will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey. We can talk about the reforms on the way as well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree. There is much to gain.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. There is much to gain.”
entries.menuText: “I agree. There is much to gain.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd prefer we just do the opening..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”
entries.menuText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sure. We will be in the other carr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sure. We will be in the other carriages. See you in Lachaven.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This Railway brings thousands of n..."
entries.dialogueText: “This Railway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the railway.”
entries.menuText: “This Railway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the railway.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus came to the podium with his rel..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus came to the podium with his relaxed casual posture. He then leaned to the microphone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we began driving the train out o..."
entries.dialogueText: As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me and Symon who smiled to the cameras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we began driving the train out o..."
entries.dialogueText: As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me and Gus who gave a thumbs up to the cameras.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This railway brings down travel ti..."
entries.dialogueText: “This railway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Holsord and Lachaven is now faster and more comfortable.”
entries.menuText: “This railway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Holsord and Lachaven is now faster and more comfortable.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we began driving the train out o..."
entries.dialogueText: As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me driving by myself with the locomotive assistant next to me.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Of course. We'll do the ceremony a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. We'll do the ceremony and open the upgraded railway to the public immediately after.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I took time off from my duties to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”
entries.menuText: “I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I moved up to the stage to address..."
entries.dialogueText: I moved up to the stage to address the crowd. The press was taking dozens of pictures.
entries.menuText: Move up to the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian's voice echoed in the centra..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian's voice echoed in the central station. Thousands of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the loud cheers intensified.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The new train was in pristine condi..."
entries.dialogueText: The new train was in pristine condition and the electric engine made much faster acceleration possible while providing minimal noise and maximum comfort.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“This railway project is a perfect..."
entries.dialogueText: “This railway project is a perfect example of how we can bring prosperity to the under-developed areas in between our major cities.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you at the ceremony.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you at the ceremony.”
entries.menuText: “See you at the ceremony.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The people will be satisfied with..."
entries.dialogueText: “The people will be satisfied with the improved transportation service anyway.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Additionally, a large crowd is inv..."
entries.dialogueText: “Additionally, a large crowd is invited for the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the relaxing four hour drive..."
entries.dialogueText: After the relaxing four hour drive to Lachaven, we were welcomed by celebratory citizens at Lachaven station.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian took my place on the stage t..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I'm sure each one of you will be p..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure each one of you will be proud of the achievements made during the project once we cut that ribbon. And you can get on that train yourselves.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We were all ready to begin the cere..."
entries.dialogueText: We were all ready to begin the ceremony. I gave the green-light and the opening address began.
entries.menuText: Signal Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, a stage had been erec..."
entries.dialogueText: The next day, a stage had been erected inside the central station along the new electrified railway line.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye for now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye for now.”
entries.menuText: “Goodbye for now.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl

entries.dialogueText: “Thanks, Mr. President.”

entries.title: Narrator: "We began moving towards the stage a..."
entries.dialogueText: We began moving towards the stage as the excitement was growing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It will be a good opportunity for..."
entries.dialogueText: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entries.menuText: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“People of Sordland! Welcome to the..."
entries.dialogueText: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entries.menuText: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The team left, leaving the rest of..."
entries.dialogueText: The team left, leaving the rest of the evening to prepare for the big day tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The aim with the L-1 Railway was t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The aim with the L-1 Railway was to improve development in rural areas and cities in between Holsord and Lachaven to create economic growth in the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions.”
entries.menuText: “The aim with the L-1 Railway was to improve development in rural areas and cities in between Holsord and Lachaven to create economic growth in the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Without further ado, I invite the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have to thank the mind behind t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have to thank the mind behind the railway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entries.menuText: “We have to thank the mind behind the railway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Loo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: The chanting and excitement from the crowd intensified. A large group began singing the national anthem.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”
entries.menuText: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Holsordians! Welcome to the openin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Holsordians! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entries.menuText: “Holsordians! I welcome you today to our opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“None of this would be possible wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister Gus Manger. Please come over here.”
entries.menuText: “None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister Gus Manger. Please come over here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Like the good old campaign days.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Like the good old campaign days.”
entries.menuText: “Like the good old campaign days.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We will show our best face tomorro..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will show our best face tomorrow. Meanwhile, I'll make sure that our message of improving the countryside will get across.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chanting from the crowd continu..."
entries.dialogueText: The chanting from the crowd continued. Some were yelling the motto of Holsord; High above all.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At the beginning of this journey w..."
entries.dialogueText: “At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entries.menuText: “At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our intention with the L-1 Railway..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”
entries.menuText: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Trust me, our work is far from ove..."
entries.dialogueText: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”
entries.menuText: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Things were certainly easier back..."
entries.dialogueText: “Things were certainly easier back then.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“We had our disagreements, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: “We had our disagreements, but the important thing was the outcome. Sordish people got what they needed for a long time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon stepped in for a comment."
entries.dialogueText: Symon stepped in for a comment.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Agreed. Every single press outlet..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I think all of us do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I think all of us do.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Symon, you deserve a lot of credit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entries.menuText: “Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your kind words. It..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Beginning with the President who p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank all who were involved in L-1.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“On another note. It goes without m..."
entries.dialogueText: “On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Symon mentioned the beginning of a Sordish economic recovery and the plans to stop the recession altogether.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Gus continued to explain how this not only helps Holsord but also many areas along the path of the upgraded railway.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: The crowd began cheering my name.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: The crowd looked quite large. I spotted many party members among them.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I welcome you Holsordians today as..."
entries.dialogueText: “I welcome you Holsordians today as a proud servant of this country.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl

entries.dialogueText: “Our aim with this project is obvious: to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger

entries.dialogueText: “Holsord! It is great to be here in this beautiful capital that does so much good for this country.”

entries.dialogueText: Symon gave me a large pair of scissors to commence the opening while the crowd was watching.

entries.dialogueText: “The journey to Lachaven should take about four hours and the rest of us will be in the carriage with you.”
